name: precision-kit
description: 26 project-agnostic engineering skills (incremental code map for ranged reads, works-on-every-machine portability checks with clean-room proof, recon, live modernization against current registries/advisories, modern integration, legacy cleanup, testing, verification, debugging, security, CI, docs, performance, migrations, UI checks) plus hooks that keep the code map current, inject build/test commands at session start and block commits that leak secrets or fail checks.

verify_on_commit.title: Verify on commit
verify_on_commit.description: Run the project's lint/typecheck/build/test for changed projects before every git commit and block on failures. Secret scanning always runs.

freshness_on_start.title: Live freshness note at session start
freshness_on_start.description: Show a one-line summary of outdated/vulnerable/deprecated dependencies at session start. Uses a daily cache refreshed in the background, so startup is never delayed.
